lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately 20 high-luminance circular pixel clusters (>180/255) arranged in four roughly equidistant longitudinal rows; vertical spacing between centroids is approximately 1.5 to 2 times the average blob diameter.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the primary blobs to create a coordinate-like grid, though local luminance is heavily modulated by high-frequency caustic interference from the surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Single prominent horizontal linear feature across the upper-mid flank, defined by a sharp vertical luminance gradient transitioning from high-intensity surface reflections to lower-intensity mid-body shading.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Approximately 8-12 high-luminance blobs of reduced diameter relative to flank blobs, distributed within the first dorsal fin silhouette with a higher concentration observed toward the anterior margin.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced dynamic caustic network (surface light refraction) overlaying the primary biological patterning, creating a non-static lattice of high-intensity lines across the dorsal and lateral regions.
